2440-3490-8250.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2440-3490-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
2440-3490-8250.notes: If there is at least one other Servo on the battlefield to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

240-1115-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-1115-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

4279-6112-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6112-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

719-2438-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-2438-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat from step 3.

1580-4871-6255-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7010-7736.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2523-2869-5284.description:
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it.
When Blood Vassal dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Blood Vassal that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Blood Vassal token

1309-2103-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and exiling Ephemerate.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

252-1575-3967-5776.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
252-1575-3967-5776.notes: The combo can instead by started by sacrificing an untapped noncreature Food to its own ability. This will replace step 1 for the first iteration and add {2} to the mana needed. After the first iteration, follow the steps above as normal.

292-4968-7267.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-4968-7267.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1395-2113-3459-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1061-1322-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-1322-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-1322-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

2692-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4153-6575-6968--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4153-6575-6968--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

454-1376-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
454-1376-1978.description:
Cause Priest of Titania to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat from step 2.

1286-4050-6290.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional creature.
1286-4050-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Lightwheel Enhancements enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightwheel Enhancements attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1496-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-2919-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

602-3591-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
602-3591-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.
602-3591-6282.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Necropotence triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2 as applicable for each remaining trigger.
Discard cards down until your maximum hand size, as the cleanup step is still onging.
Repeat from step 2.

277-880-3534.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-3534.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-2557-6348.notablePrerequisites: You control a Dragon and/or have a Dragon card in hand.
1409-2557-6348.description:
Activate Sarkhan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sarkhan enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, either choosing a Dragon you control or revealing a Dragon card from your hand and creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1974-4112.description:
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Quicksilver Gargantuan enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Quicksilver Gargantuan triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.
